_comment: Measured verdicts, not inferred ones. oracle_map.py refuses to answer 'did this commit break an existing test?' from git alone, so this file records what was actually run. Every drt test registered in src/drt/test/CMakeLists.txt at this sha was executed with the STOCK SHIPPED binary inside ghcr.io/vibeic/vibeic-eda:0.2.63 (openroad -version = 26Q3-1110-g2f9fbcd47e, i.e. built from exactly this sha), judged by the repo's OWN judge test/regression_test.sh with TEST_CHECK_LOG=True -- not by exit code, which FORK_PATCH_AUDIT.md s4 records as vacuous for a suite that signals by printing. Scope: the drt module only. Tests of every other module are ABSENT here, which oracle_map renders as COULD-NOT-MEASURE, never as a pass.
scope: src/drt only -- 15 of 15 tests registered for drt at this sha
